title: Bafana Recall & Super Eagles Squads: AFCON 2027 Betting Angles for African Punters
flags: Veteran striker **Bongani “Singh” Khumalo** – who has been out of the national set‑up for three years – has been named in Pitso Mosimane’s first Bafana Bafana squad for the upcoming AFCON 2027 qualifiers.
The reaction from Singh’s camp was a mixture of gratitude and a clear demand for regular playing time.

The latest article **“Who’s missing from Mosimane’s first Bafana squad?”** listed the notable absentees – notably the midfield duo of Thulani Hlatshwayo and forward Lyle Foster, both nursing injuries.
Coach Éric Chelle named a 24‑man roster split into two groups – one for the Madagascar qualifier and another for the Guinea‑Bissau match, with a friendly against Russia on the side.
Mosimane is expected to release the official list later today, after the “Who’s missing from Mosimane’s first Bafana squad?” piece.
